A new coalition of Indonesian journalists supporting Palestine was officially launched in Jakarta on Saturday, aiming to amplify Palestinian narratives, combat misinformation, and strengthen cooperation between Indonesian and Palestinian media organizations. The coalition seeks to promote accurate reporting, raise awareness of the Palestinian cause, and honor journalists killed by Israeli forces. Indonesia's Deputy Foreign Minister Anis Matta praised Palestinian journalists' sacrifices and emphasized the importance of highlighting the human dimension of the Palestinian struggle to reach audiences worldwide.
